Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 7446- 1987 



Indian Standard 

DIMENSIONS FOR 

CHISEL SHANKS AND CHUCK BUSHINGS 

FOR PNEUMATIC CHIPPERS 

( First Revision ) 



( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensions for chisel shanks and chuck bushings for use with pneumatic 
chippers conforming to IS : 7605-1985 'Specification for pneumatic chippers'.

Note 1 — The octagonal shape on the tool side and dimension, e, are given for information only. 

Note 2— If a smaller shank size is needed, that is, nominal size 10, dimensions given for light rivet snap shanks in IS : 6572-1987 may be adopted. 
Note 3 — The cutting edge of the chisel should be parallel to one of the sides of the hexagon. 

Note 4 — ^ The permitted errors of concentricity between the cylindrical portion,j/, and the hexagonal portion, 5, are included in the tolerances given in the above tables; 
the 'GO* gauge for dimensions tf and 5 should, therefore, be a composite gauge, ihis remark is also applicable to the measurements of the corresponding chuck -bushings.

2.2.1 As an alternative to the tool with hexagonal shank, the hexagon portion may be replaced by a 
cylindrical portion with the same length, /i, and a diameter, 5, equal to the width across flats of the 
hexagon {see Fig. 1 ).

FIG. 1 ALTERNATIVE SHANK 



3. Designation 



3.1 A chisel shank of Type A having nominal size 17 and length, /, 60 mm shall be designated as: 

Chisel Shank Parallel 17 x 60 IS : 7446 

3.2 A chisel shank of Type B having nominal size 12 and length 45 mm shall be designated as: 

Chisel Shank Hexagonal 12 x 45 IS : 7446 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard was first issued in 1974 based on ISO Recommendation R 1180. 

This standard has now been revised to align it with ISO 1 1 80-1 983 'Shanks for pneumatic tools 
and fittings — dimensions of chuck bushings', issued by the International Organization for Standardization 
(ISO). 



Printed at Printrade, New Delhi, India
